Order Under Section 03 of the Regulation of Election Expenditure Act.No. 3 of 2023
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with election expenditure regulations and campaign spending limits for the Local Authorities Election scheduled for May 6, 2025. It includes details about authorized spending amounts for candidates, political parties, and independent groups contesting in specific local authorities, along with reporting requirements for election expenses. This falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) as it covers electoral processes, campaign regulations, and election administration matters.
